entries.declaration: function bills(uint256 id) view returns (address owner, bool settled, bool active, uint128 principal, uint128 premium, uint64 termStart, uint64 maturity, uint256 bonusDebt)
entries.explanation: Individual bill state in exact owner,settled,active,principal,premium,termStart,maturity,bonusDebt order. ID zero is valid. Preserve active and settled independently; use stored maturity for cohorts.
entries.units: ID is unscaled and namespaced by chain+contract; principal/premium STANDARD18; timestamps Unix seconds; bonusDebt frontend WAD accumulator checkpoint.
limitations: Selected publisher frontend ABI, not verified Solidity or complete deployed/admin/event coverage. Values require authenticated chain, contract and observation block; no signing/submission authority.
